question: Choose the correct one-word substitute: A person who eats excessively or greedily
solution:
The correct answer is: **Glutton**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glutton"** refers to a person who eats excessively or greedily, often beyond what is necessary. (पेटू)
 
 
• **Example:** He is such a glutton that he ate the entire cake by himself.
 
 
• **Explanation:** A glutton is characterized by overindulgence, especially in food. (पेटूपन का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।)
 
 
• **Example:** During the buffet, the glutton filled his plate multiple times without considering others.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Glutton**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gourmet** (खाद्य-विशेषज्ञ): A person who has a refined taste in food and drink, often considered a connoisseur.
 
 
• **Example:** The gourmet chef prepared an exquisite five-course meal.
 
 
 
• **Epicure** (रसिक): A person who takes particular pleasure in fine food and drink.
 
 
• **Example:** An epicure will never settle for anything less than a perfectly cooked meal.
 
 
 
• **Sybarite** (भोगवादी): A person who is self-indulgent in their fondness for luxury and pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** The sybarite spent his fortune on luxurious vacations and fine wines.
 
 

38:T479,
The correct answer is **option 1.**
